description: Their employer share grants - RSUs, EMI, CSOP and unapproved options, Sharesave and Share Incentive Plans - each with how much has vested and how much is still to vest, in shares and pounds at today's price, the next vest date and amount, and when the whole grant has vested. The same figures as Employer Share Schemes on their Assets page. Use for 'when do my next shares vest', 'how many RSUs have I got left to vest', or what they would leave behind by changing jobs now.
name: get_employer_shares
title: Employer shares and vesting
